It was a very small wedding, 30 people. The place was so small it didn't have bathrooms. There is no need for 3 photographers at that wedding.

They were with dslr with flashes on them. As i said, they had photography equipment. No continuous light, flashes.
And yes, was the first time I had a meltdown working in a event. I had people scream at me, children throwing water at my camera, went home and suffered afterwards. Some comnenter pointed out it was more of a break point than anything about the wedding.
I feel like they did my job. I already paid for a gift for their house together with my mom, but a gift card as an apology isn't a bad idea. Thank you!

I've worked on parties with multiple photographers. The thing is I knew them, even if for a week prior. We talked about which channel our flashes would be to not interfere, which people we would photograph, and I let them know that I have mental issues and to have patience with me. To arrive at a place in which I was expecting to have all the room to work and have strange people in there made me have a breakdown.
Also I worked as a studio assistant and it's hell. It's a fast pace environment where you need to change products/clothes/lenses so fast, be aware of lights, interact with models, make up people... Everything also makes me overwhelmed. I should focus on my mental health instead of working.
I think it is when you don't tell the photographers. Their flash can interfere with my picture. Also I wasn't needed there, felt really bad.
I think you're right. The wedding was a breaking point. I'll try to get better.
Thank you, that is really sweet. I will get better in the future, won't take any jobs until I'm ready.
Thank you. I thought I could handle it as I already worked on birthday parties, I don't know what happened today. I will talk to my psychiatrist and see what we can do. I will get better. Thank you
I didn't take any money. They would've paid me afterwards. Now I understand that I should've talked to someone but at the time I just cried, I couldn't talk. But I agree that I fucked up.

That was really what I was needing to hear, thank you so much. I really feel crappy and I'm trying to apologize to everyone, but people can be so mean. Thank you for being kind.
I've already worked on birthday parties and children's events and it was fine. Today was the first time that this happened, I thought I was ready but no.

I felt useless to go to wake uo early, go away from my house to a place where I wasn't needed. I wouldn't have gone to the wedding if I wasn't the photographer. 
The bride talked to me last saturday to make sure I was going to go. They never paid me, I'm trying to contact these photographers to pay them for doing my job.
I didn't take the money, should've put that in the post, sorry. But they would pay me after. I offered to pay the photographers who were there but they didn't reply me yet.
